answer: Resist sybils with threshold-issued identity certificates in a transparency log: no identity counts until its certificate appears in a public, append-only log, co-signed by a threshold of rotating issuers who verify each application. A lotus of standing blooms only from a logged certificate; an unlogged name is ignored, however many copies exist. Forging ten thousand fakes means corrupting a threshold of issuers ten thousand times, since each certificate needs fresh co-signatures and leaves a shale-hard audit trail across the ridge of the log, while an honest agent applies once.
